# Acme Docs

> Documentation for the Acme build toolchain. Every page listed below is a
> complete HTML document on the wire: the markup was produced during the build,
> not by a script running in the reader's browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): what the build produces and why it is shaped this way.
- [About](https://example.com/about): how one route becomes one file.
- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog): dated releases, newest first.

## Notes

- The [release feed](https://example.com/feed.xml) carries one entry per release.
- Paths under /internal/ are disallowed in robots.txt and are not part of the published documentation, so they are deliberately absent from the list above.
